title: Watercolor 132 Pine Needle Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in the Forest District of Watercolor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Sitting spa- Private Pool *Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $60 per day*- 4 adult bikes provided- Parking for up to 4 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Perched upon one of the largest lots in WaterColor, 132 Pine Needle Way is a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom that sleeps up to 12 guests. Delight in access to the expanded WaterColor Beach Club, multiple community pools, and gorgeous scenic views throughout the area. Guests will love spending tranquil days in the enclosed outdoor living space or lounging by the pool, followed by relaxing evenings in the sitting spa.Designed by the renowned architects of Caldwell-Cline, this lovely home welcomes guests with a wide porch bedecked with padded wicker furniture and an overhead fan. Inside, reclaimed heart pine floors, shiplap walls, and cypress-beamed ceilings add understated elegance to the comfortable living space, furnished with 2 plush white couches, matching armchairs, a 65” Smart TV, and Sonos soundbar. The airy kitchen seamlessly connects to the living area and features custom cabinetry and Thermador appliances. Continue into the dining alcove with a pale wood round table that seats 6. This level has 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. A screened porch with woven furniture and a picnic table begs guests to unwind with a tart glass of lemonade on a breezy afternoon. The yard backs up to a stunning nature preserve, providing a secluded oasis to enjoy the covered veranda, crystalline pool, and sitting spa.Sunlight streams through the spacious stairway leading to the second floor’s lofted lounge space—an ideal spot to while away hours with the latest bestselling novel. Off the landing are 3 charming bedrooms with vaulted ceilings. The first has a king bed, the second 2 queens, and the third is an excellent option for children with 4 twin beds and 2 trundles.With resort-style neighborhood amenities and a private outdoor paradise, enjoy the best of Watercolor at 132 Pine Needle Way. There is parking for 4 vehicles, and guests who prefer to explore on two wheels can take advantage of the 4 complimentary adult bikes. For private beach access, head to the WaterColor Beach Club or the access off Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book this inviting home for a Florida getaway today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 4 Twin Beds and 2 Trundle Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.

With resort-style neighborhood amenities and a private outdoor paradise, enjoy the best of Watercolor at 132 Pine Needle Way. There is parking for 4 vehicles, and guests who prefer to explore on two wheels can take advantage of the 4 complimentary adult bikes.
